tools.name: get_role_sound
tools.description: Choose this when the task calls for a sound for a named event or interaction — a button click, purchase success, error beep, level-up, dialogue blip, notification. Pass the role as plain words: role ids (click, success, purchase-success, dialogue-blip, notification…) and common aliases (button click, ka-ching, jump scare, text blip…) are all accepted. Returns a qualified candidate for that role when one satisfies the requested constraints, with MP3 and WAV URLs, 2-3 alternates and the family page for browsing more. Free use is MP3: downloading a WAV takes a download pack, and wav_url without one answers 402 wav_needs_pack with the mp3_url to use. Download selected files locally and retain originals. Task-permitted processing requires a recipe, output SHA256, renewed file checks and a listening check. Other task-permitted sources or local synthesis may be mixed in. Optional style: crisp (short, bright, dry), soft (darker, gentler), spacious (reverb, longer tail), balanced (default: most typical). For multiple events consider get_sound_set; use search_sounds for a description or a gap. These are task branches, not a fixed sequence. Unknown roles return not_found with the full role list; GET https://sfxmint.com/api/v1/roles lists roles with aliases.

role.description: Role id or alias, e.g. 'click', 'button click', 'purchase-success', 'ka-ching', 'error beep', 'level-up', 'dialogue blip', 'notification'

style.description: Optional. balanced (default) = the family's most typical take; crisp = short, bright, dry; soft = darker, gentler; spacious = reverb, longer tail

max_duration_ms.description: Hard maximum length of the sound in milliseconds: a file may run longer with near-silence after the sound (audible_ms is the sound, duration_ms the file; checks say which was met).

loop.description: Require prepared loop metadata; seam evidence is returned separately.

format.description: Delivery format the candidate must have (ogg = Ogg Vorbis, only sounds published before 2026-10-14 have it); default MP3 and WAV URLs. Downloading a WAV takes a download pack.

tools.name: get_sound
tools.description: Get full metadata for one sound by slug, including download URLs, description and acoustics measured from the WAV (silence before the sound, where it peaks, audible length, attack, tail, brightness, levels, character labels).

tools.name: get_sound_set
tools.description: Get a coherent set of sounds for an app or game in one call — one sound per role, with format metadata, hashes and stable download URLs. Use it when the task needs a whole kit; use get_role_sound for one event. Listen to the files in context. Sets include UI styles, game and app scenarios (fantasy-rpg covers spells, combat, loot, quests and level-up), acoustic-drum-kit, animal-calls (15 isolated calls), and dungeon-traps (6 isolated mechanisms).

format.description: File format for selection and checks (default MP3, which downloads free; WAV takes a download pack; OGG only among sounds published before 2026-10-14). Legacy urls remains MP3; download_urls follows this format.

set.description: Set id (default ui-crisp). Includes acoustic-drum-kit, animal-calls and dungeon-traps alongside the UI and scenario sets listed in the enum.

tools.name: search_sounds
tools.description: Free-text search over the SFXMint library of free CC0 sound effects. Use it for sound descriptions, additional constraints or gaps left by another tool. Choose get_role_sound for a named event or get_sound_set for multiple events when that fits the task; these are task branches, not a fixed sequence. Hard constraints (duration, loop, format, excluded words) always apply. results hold sounds whose text has every word of the query. When there are none, closest lists the nearest sounds that meet every hard constraint, best first, each with missing_terms: judge them from title and description and let the user listen. library_fit says how well the library covers the request (full, close, weak, none). Returns direct, hotlinkable MP3 and WAV URLs and verified OGG (Vorbis) URLs where available, no attribution required, plus acoustics measured from the WAV (onset_ms, peak_ms, audible_ms, attack_ms, tail_ms, centroid_hz, peak_dbfs, rms_dbfs), character labels like 'bright · punchy · tight', loop/file-QC status, and score/match as ranking evidence only (role = known role default, exact = all words hit, partial = some words hit, semantic = nearest by meaning). Free use is MP3: downloading a WAV takes a download pack, and wav_url without one answers 402 wav_needs_pack with the mp3_url to use. A measured one-shot with silence before or after it also has trimmed_mp3_url and trimmed_wav_url: the same sound without that silence, counted as the same sound.

query.description: Use concise English search terms for the source or event, action and essential audible traits from the user's request or project context: 'door slam', 'soft UI confirmation chime', 'coin pickup'. A single clear source such as 'thunder' is valid; do not pad it. Translate other languages while preserving meaning. Avoid full generation prompts, app backstory, synonym lists and invented materials or environments: full matches must cover every query word. Put duration, loop and format requirements in their separate fields. If no full match exists, inspect closest and missing_terms; simplify only optional wording, never silently drop a required trait.

category.description: Optional category slug: ui, retro-game, transition, impact, ambience, water, fire-electric, footsteps, door, mechanical, paper-fabric, glass, animal, crowd, cartoon, magic-scifi, horror, feedback, instrument, office, human, vehicle, household

max_duration_ms.description: Hard maximum length of the sound in milliseconds: a file may run longer with near-silence after the sound (audible_ms is the sound, duration_ms the file; checks say which was met).

loop.description: Require (true) or exclude (false) a candidate marked with prepared loop metadata; seam evidence is returned separately.

format.description: Delivery format (ogg = Ogg Vorbis, only sounds published before 2026-10-14 have it); loop=true defaults to WAV when omitted. Downloading a WAV takes a download pack.
